usage: Treat these files as static assets under web/public; with Vite, refer to import.meta.env.BASE_URL + 'assets/...' (or /assets/... for root deployment). UI icons are imported from lucide-react via src/components/Icon.tsx; file-type icons are compiled from @iconify-json/vscode-icons via src/features/files/FileTypeIcon.tsx.
